provenance.organization: University of Agricultural Sciences, Raichur (UAS Raichur) & ICAR
provenance.document: Package of Practices for High Yielding Crops of North-Eastern Dry Zone of Karnataka
provenance.licensing: Public Agricultural Extension & Farmer Advisory Material

commercial_fertilizers_per_acre.timing: Split into 3 equal doses: 30, 60, and 90 DAS

split_schedule.details: Full P (DAP) + 50% K (MOP) + 10 kg Zinc Sulphate + 25 kg Urea
Top dressing: 40 kg Urea per acre + intercultivation
Top dressing: 40 kg Urea + remaining 25 kg MOP + foliar spray 1% 19:19:19
Foliar spray of 1% Magnesium Sulphate + 1% Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) to prevent leaf reddening

organic_supplements: Well decomposed Farmyard Manure (FYM): 4-5 tonnes/acre before final ploughing
Neem cake @ 100 kg/acre to manage soil pests and slow-release nitrogen
precautions: Never apply Urea on dry soil; always follow with light irrigation or apply under soil moisture.
Do not mix Zinc Sulphate directly with phosphatic fertilizers (DAP/SSP) to avoid insoluble zinc phosphate precipitate.

commercial_fertilizers_per_acre.timing: Split into 3 equal doses: basal, tillering, and panicle initiation

split_schedule.details: 100% P (DAP) + 50% K (MOP) + 25% N (Urea) + 10 kg Zinc Sulphate
Top dress 50% N (35 kg Urea) after draining standing water
Top dress remaining 25% N (18 kg Urea) + remaining 50% K (18 kg MOP)

organic_supplements: Dhaincha / Sunnhemp green manure incorporation @ 20-25 kg seed/acre 45 days before puddling
Azospirillum & PSB biofertilizers @ 2 kg/acre mixed with 100 kg FYM
precautions: Maintain thin film of water (2-3 cm) during vegetative stage; do not submerge completely.
Stop nitrogen top dressing 40 days before expected harvest.

split_schedule.details: Full DAP + 50% MOP + 20 kg Urea + 10 kg Zinc Sulphate
Side dressing: 45 kg Urea + 22 kg MOP, followed by earthing up
Top dressing: 45 kg Urea under optimum soil moisture

organic_supplements: Azotobacter seed treatment @ 250 g/10 kg seed
precautions: Maize is highly sensitive to waterlogging at germination and knee-high stages; provide field drainage.

commercial_fertilizers_per_acre.timing: Basal application to enhance protein synthesis

split_schedule.details: 100% P & N (DAP @ 45 kg/acre) placed 5 cm below seed depth
Foliar spray of 2% Urea or 1% 19:19:19 to prevent premature senescing

organic_supplements: Rhizobium leguminosarum seed inoculation @ 250 g/10 kg seed + PSB (Phosphorus Solubilizing Bacteria)
precautions: Do not apply excessive chemical nitrogen; legumes fix atmospheric nitrogen symbiotically.
Avoid irrigation at peak flowering to prevent flower abortion.
